Welcome to
Woodcliff Hotel & Spa
Stunning views, well-appointed rooms, and a host of bespoke experiences are waiting for you at Woodcliff Hotel & Spa, an iconic Rochester, NY hotel with a history as rich as its future. Here, guests can indulge in an all-inclusive getaway, featuring the Spa at Woodcliff, voted best New Spa in America, our award-winning Horizons Modern Kitchen + Wine Bar, a 9-hole golf course, and over 70-acres of hiking trails in our backyard.

Elevate your meetings and events at our premier venue with 14,000+ sq ft of exceptional space, including a 6,400 sq ft Event Center and 10 elegant meeting rooms. Amidst the lush green hills and the picturesque backdrop of the Rochester city skyline, the Woodcliff Hotel & Spa offers couples an unparalleled setting for their memorable wedding. Whether exchanging vows in our elegant grand ballroom or celebrating under the stars in a breathtaking outdoor reception, your special day will be nothing short of magical.

pages.title: Frequently Asked Questions | Woodcliff Hotel New York
pages.text:
Frequently Asked Questions | Woodcliff Hotel New York
Skip to content
FAQ Cogwheel Marketing 2026-01-30T12:19:48+00:00
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Are there age restrictions for spa guests? Cogwheel Marketing 2024-01-16T19:16:33+00:00
Are there age restrictions for spa guests?
Massages are prohibited to guests under 16, and a parent is required to be present for massages for guests ages 16 to 18. Wraps are prohibited to guests under 18, and facials are prohibited to guests under 15, with a parent needing to be present for guests receiving facials ages 15 to 18. For our younger guests, we offer manicures, pedicures, and salon services as an alternative.
How old do I need to be to reserve a room? Cogwheel Marketing 2024-01-12T20:43:52+00:00
How old do I need to be to reserve a room?
You must be 21 years or older to reserve a room.
Do you have to be a guest to use the pool or fitness center? Cogwheel Marketing 2026-10-14T14:38:14+00:00
Do you have to be a guest to use the pool or fitness center?
The pool and fitness center is restricted to hotel guests only. Our indoor and outdoor pools are open.
I booked on a third-party reservation website and need to make a change to my reservation, how can I do this? Cogwheel Marketing 2024-01-12T20:44:43+00:00
I booked on a third-party reservation website and need to make a change to my reservation, how can I do this?
Please contact the website s customer service team that you booked with.
Do you offer transportation from the hotel? Cogwheel Marketing 2024-01-12T21:22:07+00:00
Do you offer transportation from the hotel?
At this time, we do not offer transportation. There are several options if you need a ride to the hotel, from the airport or elsewhere, that our front desk would be happy to assist you with.
Does Woodcliff have a fitness center? Cogwheel Marketing 2024-01-12T21:23:25+00:00
Does Woodcliff have a fitness center?
We have an extensive fitness center with treadmills, ellipticals, free weights, and various weight machines. It is located in the lower level, past the pool.
Do you have handicap accessible rooms? Cogwheel Marketing 2024-01-12T21:23:49+00:00
Do you have handicap accessible rooms?
Yes, we have rooms that offer accessible features ranging from wheelchair-friendly room layouts, roll-in showers, bathroom grab bars, and we gladly welcome your service animal.
Is Wi-Fi available throughout the hotel? Cogwheel Marketing 2026-09-30T20:31:42+00:00
Is Wi-Fi available throughout the hotel?
High speed Wi-Fi access is available throughout the hotel and is included as part of our resort fee.
Do you allow dogs? Cogwheel Marketing 2026-07-16T21:36:10+00:00
Do you allow dogs?
Yes, we welcome up to two pets per room (75 lbs. per pet). A non-refundable $75 per-stay pet fee applies, and pets must stay leashed, attended, and out of pool, fitness, and dining areas. A designated pet relief area is available on-site.
Are there cribs and cots available for my child? Cogwheel Marketing 2024-01-12T21:25:26+00:00
Are there cribs and cots available for my child?
Yes, based on availability. They can be requested by visiting or contacting our front desk.
What does the Resort Fee include? Cogwheel Marketing 2026-09-30T20:30:37+00:00
What does the Resort Fee include?
Our $15 resort fee includes 2 bottled waters in your room, 2 cups of Starbucks drip coffee from our Craftsman Cafe , access to our hiking trails on-property and use of our bicycles, golf clubs, snowshoes, and more.
What taxes and fees should I expect? Cogwheel Marketing 2026-09-30T20:31:12+00:00
What taxes and fees should I expect?
In addition to the standard New York State sales tax (8%), there is a 6% room occupancy tax that is required by Monroe County. We also require a $15 resort fee.
Where can I get breakfast? Cogwheel Marketing 2026-10-07T16:14:34+00:00
Where can I get breakfast?
Breakfast is available at the Craftsman Cafe and Horizons Modern Kitchen + Wine Bar during the below hours.
Craftsman Cafe
Daily 7am – 11am
Horizons Modern Kitchen & Wine Bar
Monday-Wednesday 7am – 10am
Thursday-Friday 7am – 11am
Saturday-Sunday 7am – 10:30am
Where can I get lunch? Cogwheel Marketing 2026-10-05T20:32:39+00:00
Where can I get lunch?
Lunch is available at Horizons Modern Kitchen + Wine Bar Tuesday-Friday from 11:30am – 1:30pm. Weekend brunch is served Saturday and Sunday from 10:30am – 1:30pm.
Do you allow smoking in any rooms? Cogwheel Marketing 2023-09-26T21:41:24+00:00
Do you allow smoking in any rooms?
Woodcliff Hotel & Spa is a non-smoking property.
How close to the airport are you? Cogwheel Marketing 2023-09-26T21:41:06+00:00
How close to the airport are you?
Woodcliff Hotel & Spa is a short 20 minute drive from Rochester Frederick Douglass International Airport.
Should I make dinner reservations in advance? Cogwheel Marketing 2023-09-27T16:09:56+00:00
Should I make dinner reservations in advance?
We do recommend that you make dinner reservations in advance to our Horizons Modern Kitchen + Wine Bar. View the menu and make reservations at www.horizonsmodernkitchen.com .
Are there refrigerators in the room? Cogwheel Marketing 2025-01-30T15:27:04+00:00
Are there refrigerators in the room?
Yes, every room has a mini fridge for your convenience.
Is stayover service available? Cogwheel Marketing 2023-09-26T21:40:05+00:00
Is stayover service available?
Stayover service is available upon request only.
Are there safes in the room? Cogwheel Marketing 2023-09-26T21:39:45+00:00
Are there safes in the room?
Yes, every room includes a safe. The front desk is also a safe place to store valuables for you.
I did not receive my confirmation or cancellation letter, how can I receive a copy? Cogwheel Marketing 2024-01-16T19:21:02+00:00
I did not receive my confirmation or cancellation letter, how can I receive a copy?
To request a copy of your confirmation or cancellation letter, please contact us here and we will be happy to assist you.

Amenities Services Cogwheel Marketing 2026-10-14T14:38:08+00:00
Amenities & Services
Immerse yourself in a realm of luxury and ease amidst the wealth of amenities provided at Woodcliff Hotel & Spa. Relax and unwind at our lavish spa, where skilled therapists deliver an assortment of therapies for complete rejuvenation. Maintain an active lifestyle at our fitness center, engage in leisurely pursuits like golf amid breathtaking scenery or take a revitalizing plunge in our pools.
The Spa at Woodcliff
Horizons Modern Kitchen & Wine Bar
USGA Rated Nine-Hole Golf Course
Patio for Sunbathing
Indoor & Outdoor Pool
Fitness Center
Craftsman Café Open Daily 7:00 a.m. – 11:00 a.m.
Complimentary Self-Parking
Onsite ATM
Pet Friendly
THE SPA AT WOODCLIFF
It s with great pleasure, The Woodcliff Hotel & Spa announces the transformation and expansion of the Spa at Woodcliff. Locally known as the place to unwind and let it all go, the Spa at Woodcliff has been completely remodeled for a new chapter. The Spa at Woodcliff offers an array of treatments from Massages, Facials, and Body Treatments to manicures, pedicures, designer hair styles and special event hair or make-up services.
LEARN MORE
HORIZONS MODERN KITCHEN & WINE BAR
Horizons Modern Kitchen + Wine Bar features a seasonally inspired menu of refined American fare, composed of local and thoughtfully sourced ingredients, paired with our award-winning wine list and a signature collection of craft cocktails. Situated atop the county’s highest point, our dining room boasts stunning views, where the rolling pastoral hills of the Finger Lakes meet the bustling cityscape of Downtown Rochester.
LEARN MORE
INDOOR & OUTDOOR POOLS
Take a refreshing dip in our warm indoor pool, open year-round for a relaxing escape any time of day. Our pools are open and available for your enjoyment.
LEARN MORE
HEALTH & FITNESS
For those seeking an active escape, our retreat offers a modern fitness center equipped with the latest equipment and facilities. Whether you prefer strength training or cardiovascular exercises, our fitness center has everything you need to maintain your fitness routine. For nature enthusiasts, our vast hiking trails provide the perfect opportunity to connect with the great outdoors. Lace up your hiking boots and embark on a journey through 70-acres of hiking trails with scenic landscapes, meandering through lush forests right in our backyard.
Free Weights
Sauna, Lockers, and Showers
Cardio and Strength Circuit Equipment
Private Yoga/Pilates Studio
NINE-HOLE GOLF COURSE
Masterfully designed atop Monroe County’s highest point, The Links at Woodcliff is a public, USGA rated, regulation golf course. With incomparable views of the Bristol Hills and Rochester Skyline, The Links at Woodcliff has been a staple in the region for over 3 decades.
LEARN MORE
THE CRAFTSMAN CAFÉ
Fuel your day with breakfast from the on-site Craftsman Café. An assortment of coffee, pastries, juices and bottled water are available daily. The Craftsman Café proudly brews Starbucks coffee. Hours: Daily 7:00 am 11:00 am
EXPLORE MENU
PET FRIENDLY
Woodcliff Hotel & Spa is proud to welcome pets, making it easy to bring your four-legged family members along on your getaway. With designated pet-friendly rooms and outdoor relief areas, we’ve created a comfortable experience for both you and your companions. A pet policy and pet fee apply.
